newsitem.title: ZAIRE: Zaire's Mobutu leaves for talks with rebel leader.
newsitem.headline: Zaire's Mobutu leaves for talks with rebel leader.

text.p: Zaire's President Mobutu Sese Seko flew out of Kinshasa on Friday for the Congolese port of Pointe Noire, heading for talks at sea with rebel leader Laurent Kabila on ending Zaire's civil war, witnesses and officials said.
Mobutu's plane left at 1008 GMT. The ailing president had arrived at Kinshasa airport in a motorcade amid heavy security.
Armoured personnel carriers escorted Mobutu's car to the tarmac and he walked a few steps to the aircraft.
Kabila left Zaire's second city Lubumbashi early on Friday and arrived in the Angolan capital Luanda, from where he was to fly to a South African naval ship in international waters for the talks.
South African President Nelson Mandela was also on his way to the ship to chair the first face-to-face talks between Mobutu and Kabila which one official said would last only one day.
